errors.text_span: Im Januar 2025 liegen die Werte ebenfalls überwiegend negativ (häufig um etwa −2 Euro/MWh)
errors.evidence: This description of January 2025 is highly misleading. While the value is around -2 at the very beginning of the month, the defining feature of January is the steep plunge to the chart's minimum of approximately -6 Euro/MWh. The description completely omits this plunge and mischaracterizes the values for the month.

errors.text_span: bevor im Februar 2025 ein ausgeprägter Einbruch bis in die Nähe von etwa −6 Euro/MWh sichtbar ist
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the drop to approximately -6 Euro/MWh occurs in February 2025. The chart clearly shows this significant drop happens in January 2025. The trend in February is a recovery from this low point, not a drop.
